compactRecord.rs: Most evocative chapter of Japan's UNESCO Christian story — tiny wooden chapels on remote islands, built by the 'kakure' communities that survived 250 years underground.
compactRecord.td: Outer-island components of the UNESCO 'Hidden Christian Sites in the Nagasaki Region' (2018). Headline buildings include Egami Tenshudō on Naru Island (1918, Tetsukawa Yosuke, wooden cream-and-blue) and the brick Old Gorin Church and Kyū-Nokubi on Hi
